messages.en: I've already adjusted back to Korea's time zone.
I'm seriously the queen of adapting.
Have you adjusted to the weather too?
The weather is a different story.
It's so cold.
Dress warmly.
Don't catch a cold...
I heard you shared all the American snacks.
Yep.
I bought a ton of them,
so I gave them
to the members staying at the dorm.
Telling them to take as much as they wanted was pretty cool.
You think that was kind of cool?ㅋ
Chaewon said she really missed you.
Yeah, she didㅋㅋㄹㅋ
I missed you too.
I must be one lucky girl.
Y/n missed me too.

messages.ko: 하연아 서울콘 티켓팅 성공했어 내가 갈게
messages.en: Hayeon, I got tickets for the Seoul concert! I'll be there.
Oh wow!
I wonder if everyone managed to get tickets.
If you did, congratulations!
I'll show you my coolest side.
And for those who didn't make it,
there'll be another concert!
We'll meet then.
We'll be performing with eight members
at the same venue where we held the full-group concert.
It feels strange,
but in a good way.
LA
Hayeon.
What am I supposed to do with these baby hairs?
When I first cut them,
they behaved just fine.
But as they've grown,
why do they keep growing forward like this?
Those baby hairs are way too confident.
That's some serious overconfidence.
They could stand to lose a little confidence.
So, was the amusement park fun?
Seriously, it was incredible.
There were so many rides beyond anything I could've imagined.
I don't think I can enjoy Korean amusement parks the same way anymore.
They probably won't feel thrilling anymore.
Before one of the rides even started,
the seat
reclined all the way back,
and while I was lying like that,
it started climbing.
Then, when it dropped,
it suddenly flipped over,
so I was facing the ground,
and we went straight down vertically.
It was absolutely insane.
And then,
there was another ride.
As soon as it started,
it suddenly
tilted us face-down,
like Superman flying,
so we were hanging from the safety harness,
while riding
a roller coaster like that.
I was seriously so happy, and it was so much fun.
That day,
the sky
was full of pink and blue colors,
like cotton candy.
It didn't even feel real.
It felt like a dream.
"Wait... I'm actually at an amusement park in LA...? Just like that?"
That's exactly how it felt.
Ta-da.
The sky looked so beautiful in this photo,
so I wanted to show you.
Sullin unnie took it for me.
She snapped it while I was fixing my hair~ ^.^
The sky was so beautiful.
It looked even prettier in person.
It's a shame we couldn't see it together.
This one too.
It looked so much prettier in real life.
I wish we could've seen it together.
That day, I had really full, wavy hair,
but I tied it up because of the rides.
Then Seoah looked at me and said,
"Your hairstyle makes you look like an elegant rich lady."
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㄹ
I was so annoyed that it actually looked like that.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
I went to two amusement parks in Abu Dhabi,
and now I've been to one in LA too,
so I'm basically becoming an amusement park collector.
So far, my number one is...
Hmm...
Considering the theme, facilities, and thrill level altogether,
Ferrari World Abu Dhabi.
Number one.
Second place: Six Flags LA.
Third place: Warner Bros. Abu Dhabi.
That's my ranking.

messages.ko: 전문적인 놀이공원 유튜버같아 숏츠에 영상 올릴듯
messages.en: You sound like a professional amusement park YouTuber. I can already imagine you uploading Shorts.

messages.ko: 살면서 한번쯤은 가봐야할 놀이공원 탑3! 소개해드릴게요~
messages.en: "Here are the Top 3 amusement parks you have to visit at least once in your life!"
"??? : Wow! Where is that?"
"It's written in the video title.^^"
Where do you want to go for the spring break Signal?
I think I'd have fun anywhere.
I'm looking forward to it.
Places usually become more fun when I'm thereㅎ
Hiking?
ㅎㅎㅎㅎㅎㅎㄹ
That wouldn't be easy.
If I went hiking,
I'd probably stop halfway up the mountain at those outdoor exercise machines.
I'd become an exercise-machine zombie.
You know exactly what I mean, right?
ㅋㅎㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋ
"Ahh~ The air feels so nice~~"
"Alright, let's head back down~~"
That's probably how it'd go.
What do you think it'll end up being?
A private pool villa? Or maybe a countryside getaway?
That sounds like it'd be fun.

messages.ko: 채원이 등산 제일 안 가고 싶대요. 채원어젯밤에 하연에게 편지를 쓰겠다고 하연이랑 물놀이도 하고 하연이랑 자고 싶다고 했어요.💖💖💖💖💖💖💖🤭🤭🤭🤭🤭🤭🤭🤭🤭
messages.en: Chaewon said hiking is the last thing she'd want to do. Last night she also said she wanted to write you a letter, play in the water with you, and sleep next to you.💖💖💖💖💖💖💖🤭🤭🤭🤭🤭🤭🤭🤭🤭
Ohh.
I see.
She really
said it exactly like that?
ㅋㄹㅋㅋㄹㅋㅋㄹㅋㅎㅋㅎ
Oh, you mean she said those separatelyㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
You surprised me.
Looks like Chaewon's fallen for me, huh?ㅎ
…is what I was about to say.
Well… she already has, though.
How could anyone resist falling for me?
Y/n has already fallen for me too.
Even all my hair fell out.
There you go again...
Trying so hard to be funny.
Anyway,
I feel like a lot of fun things
are going to happen this year,
and I love that.
We'll be promoting soon,
and the Seoul concert is coming up too,
so let's see each other often.
I'm going to head off now.
Sleep well in advance.
Enjoy the remaining three hours of your day~~
And to all the Waves overseas,
have a wonderful day today too.💕💕
I'm off now~
Haranghae!😘😘🤍🩵❣️
